title: The Blackout
answer: B, the sister. The power was out from 9 to 11, so she couldn't have watched TV until ten. (The candle and the blinking clock just confirm the power cut. The low battery is a red herring.)

beats.line: Mrs. Lane was found dead during a storm. Three people were in the house. One of them is lying.
That night, the storm cut the power from nine until eleven.
The neighbour says she was reading by candlelight.
The sister says she watched her favourite show until ten.
The nephew says he was asleep since eight.
Clue one: a candle in the neighbour's room, burned halfway down.
Clue two: the nephew's alarm clock, blinking twelve o'clock.
Clue three: the sister's phone, on two percent battery.
Only one alibi doesn't add up. Who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
